summary_1line: Celestials gather to witness Arjuna’s battle as he duels Kripa, overpowering him with superior archery yet sparing him out of respect.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra stands in a jewel-studded celestial chariot amid gods and sages crowding the sky to watch Arjuna fight below.
Arjuna blows the Devadatta conch from his chariot as its thunderous sound echoes across the battlefield and heavens.
Arjuna’s arrows slice Kripa’s bow and armor apart while the two warriors face each other like twin suns on their chariots.
